description: Hi, I'm Sarthak! Sole Winner of MoES (SIH25204) at SIH '25. I am a passionate AI & Hardware dev who loves bringing code to the physical world. My projects: Autonomous UGVs, Jal Jeevan IoT nodes, AquaSENSE, and Vision AI. Tech Stack: ROS 2, OpenCV, ESP32, Python, 3D Printing. For "Field Shift", I'm building a physical Smart Agri-Node fusing NASA data with edge telemetry. I’d love to team up with folks skilled in UI/UX or Cloud/APIs to build something amazing together!
